Text S1 Enzyme activities and Excitation emission matrix fluorescence spectra

Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and catalase (CAT) activities were investigated to reveal the effects of micro-aeration on the microbial activities. To assess the influence of micro-aeration on hydrolysis, acetogenesis and methanogenesis steps, activities of protease, acetate kinase (AK), coenzyme F420 and ACS were determined, respectively. Activities of the above enzymes were determined using corresponding reagent kits (Shanghai Hengyuan, China) according to the manufacturers’ guidelines. The sludge slurry was centrifuged at 8000 rpm and the supernatant was passed through a 0.45 μm filter. A fluorescence spectrophotometer (F-7000, Hitachi, Japan) was used to obtain EEM spectra of the filtrates. The obtained spectra could be divided into five regions according to previous literature. The fluorescence regional integration (FRI) technique was utilized to calculate the fluorescent intensities of each region (Chen et al., 2003).
Text S2 The extraction of P from primary sludge solids

The P of primary sludge solids was extracted according a previous literature (Xu et al., 2023). 50 mL of the sludge was collected and freeze-dried for 48 h. After grinding and screening through the 70-mesh screen, take 0.2 g of sludge in a 50 mL centrifuge tube. Add 20 mL of 1 M MgCl2 to the centrifuge tube and mix them at 25℃ for 2 h, the P in the supernatant was regarded as Loosely-P; Sediments from the former step were then mixed with 20 mL of 0.2% 2,2-bipyridine at 50℃ for 24 h, the P in the supernatant is determined as Fe (Ⅱ)-P; Then, 20 mL of 0.5 M NH4F was added into the sediment and mixed at 25℃ for 1 h, the supernatant P was determined as Al-P; Further mix 20 mL of 0.1 M NaOH with the former sediment at 25℃ for 17 h, the supernatant P is determined as Fe (Ⅲ)-P; Continue to mix 20 mL of solution (0.3 M Na3C3H6O7 + 1 M Na2S2O4 + 1 M NaHCO3) with the sediment at 85℃ for 15 min, the supernatant P is regarded as Reductant-P; After that, mix 20 mL 1 M HCl with the obtained sediment for 16 h at 25℃, the supernatant P is determined as Ca-P; Finally, the obtained sediment is calcined at 550℃ for 2 h. After cooling, mix it with 20mL 1 M HCl at 25℃ for 16 h, the supernatant P is determined as Organic-P.

The RT-qPCR were conducted by Majorbio Bio-pharm Technology Co., Ltd (Shanghai, China). Genes encoding the formyl tetrahydrofolate synthetase (FTHFS), ACS (EC: 6.2.1.1), methyl coenzyme reductase (mcrA, EC: 2.8.4.1), and nitrate reductase (narG), related to acetogenesis, methanogenesis, and nitrogen transformation, were quantified by RT-PCR according to previous literature (Liu et al., 2022).

The 16S rRNA gene sequencing were conducted by Majorbio Bio-pharm Technology Co., Ltd. (Shanghai, China). The sludge samples were collected at the end of anaerobic fermentation (day 30). They were centrifugated at 10000 rpm for 10 min, and the pellets were stored in a sterile tube at -80°C. The DNA was extracted according to E.Z.N.A® soil kit instructions (OMEGA soil DNA Kit, Omega Bio tek, USA). The concentration and purity of DNA were determined by an ultra-micro spectrophotometer (NanoDrop2000, Thermo Scientific, USA). After quality determination by 1% agarose gel electrophoresis, the extracted DNA was amplified by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) with the universal bacterial primers 338F-806R (5′-ACTCCTACGGGGAGGCAGCAG-3′, 5′-GGACTACNNGGGTATCTAAT-3′) and archaeal primers Arch344F- Arch 915R (5'-ACGGGGYGCAGCAGGCGCGA-3', 5'-GTGCTCCCCCGCCAATTCCT-3'). The PCR products were used for the subsequent paired-end sequencing on an Illumina platform by Majorbio Bio-pharm Technology Co., Ltd.
